_readme: Every post ends with exactly 1 CTA from this list (meta.json cta_type). The goal is capturing information: comments, form fills, bookings, sign-ups. Instagram captions can't link, so IG uses 'link in bio' or a comment keyword.

comment-keyword.label: Comment KEYWORD, we DM the freebie
comment-keyword.captures: comment + DM thread, then email when we send the freebie

free-quote.label: Free quote with your top AI opportunities
free-quote.captures: name, company, work email, phone, WMS, orders per day, pain points

calculator.label: Lost-revenue / hidden-cost calculator, then free quote
calculator.captures: same form as free-quote, warmer intent

office-hours.label: Free group office hours, bring your bottleneck

newsletter.label: Newsletter sign-up
newsletter.note: Form lives in the site footer. A dedicated /newsletter page would convert better.

workshop.label: The AI Employee Accelerator, live on Zoom
workshop.share: 2 to 3 posts per channel per week while a date is open

leadMagnets._readme: Freebies promised by comment-keyword posts. status 'to-build' means it must exist before the post is approved.
